subject: INVOKE statement
notes: Rule: 'If identifier-1 is null, the EC-OO-NULL exception condition is set to exist and execution of the INVOKE statement is terminated.' (cite.py --check 14.9.23.4 OK, GR5). Typed receivers render CobolObject.RequireNonNull(recv).M(...); golden: HANDLED=EC-OO-NULL then AFTER (declarative + RESUME NEXT STATEMENT, method never ran). Probe u1.cob verified the UNIVERSAL path too (`INVOKE U MN` on a null universal -> HANDLED=EC-OO-NULL, method not run). The raise is unconditional (checking off -> fatal termination), the documented choice in the golden's header. || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (INVOKE / OO is a COBOL-2002 introduction)
